name: A leap-day stay drops out of the window on day 181

planSteps.description: Read this first: the second visit in this test must open exactly /?today=2024-08-27 (no other query params; never add fresh=1, which deletes the saved trip). Only the first visit below uses fresh=1.
Click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add), enter entry 2024-02-29 (data-testid=trip-entry) and exit 2024-02-29 (data-testid=trip-exit), and click save (data-testid=trip-save)

In the calculator's status panel (data-testid=status-panel), read the 'Latest legal exit' tile: the element data-testid=latest-exit has the text exactly "2024-11-23" and the element data-testid=latest-exit-hint, directly under it, has the text exactly "23 November 2024" (the 2024-02-29 day still counts on day 180). Read these two elements' text content; do not search the whole page, the landing band or the ring's rolling digits
Open exactly /?today=2024-08-27 (no other query params; never add fresh=1). The URL must NOT contain fresh=1 (that would delete the saved trip)

Wait until data-testid=latest-exit inside data-testid=status-panel shows a date, then read the text content of two elements: data-testid=latest-exit is exactly "2024-11-24" and data-testid=latest-exit-hint is exactly "24 November 2024" (the 2024-02-29 day has left the 180-day window on day 181, so the latest legal exit moves one day later). Read these two elements, do not search the whole page. The trip row (data-testid=trip-row) 2024-02-29 to 2024-02-29 is still listed
